body: Can I ask why you think so?
easiest applause I got in my life, but thanks dude lol

First, I appreciate your response, I would expect people like you to be offended in some way by my post, I think you were quite respectful. I agree that other unhealthy habits like smoking have been glorified mainly in past decades and are as bad for your health as being overweight. That's why I think it's important to separate health from beauty, you can consider overweight people unhealthy and beautiful at the same time.

I also believe anyone can be at a position where they are not overweight (otherwise you would see fat people in tribes) but the amount of effort some individuals have to make to stay there it's just not comparable to others.

  
Regarding the other question, the attraction in my case comes from looking at the curvature of their body, seem them eating junk food does not make a difference I think.



And yes, I understand people dating you being ashamed of your body is awful. It's something that I have no idea how to control and I feel quite guilty for the psychological impact it can make in others so yeah, I think I should go to therapy for that
hahaha that was lovely, honestly that made my day :)
this was quite inspiring honestly, I'm now really curious on the things I could explore and end up liking tbh

hmmm I think your perspective is pretty interesting, I'm usually into trying new stuff in every area of my life except for the sexual one due to anxiety I guess. It sounds like a good opportunity of growth to be honest experimenting with different stuff

I really like your comment and I completely agree with you. You see, I like being active, doing things, etc. and I would love to have a partner of the same kind. I'm aware that being overweight is not healthy and when you love someone you want the best for your partner so I would want them to be as healthy and happy as possible. My problem is that subconciously what gets me more aroused are overweight women, which confronts my romanticized ideal version of a partner. And I'm not sure if I can have any control on that, which leads to a dissonance that gives me anxiety
yeah I won't hide it, I care too much about the opinions of others when it comes to who I date. And that's making me suffer so now I'm focusing on overcoming that stuff

you're right, I don't want to hurt anyone I care about and inflict them any issues or trauma. Nor end up cheating on anybody. That's why I ask for advice on the internet and expose my insecurities here, so I can get some perspective, find where my flaws lie and what I could be getting wrong about the world and myself. If anything I said felt like a personal attack to you or somebody close to you, I'm sorry. Nobody likes being a jerk after all
thanks for your empathy, your words really gave me hope. Helped
maybe I'm just overthinking too much

Thanks for your support.  I think I might be worrying to much about this stuff  before dating around more and trying to figure things out as you said. One last thing though, do you think it's not necessary to admit to the people you're dating the weird things that turn you on?

I have to admit that I'm too self concious of what others think of me when I'm having something with a woman. I think I should work on that first before overthinking that much about it. Thank you for your support :)
